page.layout: Running head at top, centred; page number at top right. One column of text, a date line centred below it, and a catchword at the lower right. A library stamp overlaps the date line and is left out.

main_text.p: possemus Eminentiae tuae offerre, spem meam non diebus, sed aliquot mensibus operae fefellerunt; tantopere tamen confido benevolentiae in me tuae, cujus argumenta, toties mihi demonstrasti, ut facile mihi persuadeam, diuturnitate temporis nihil de ea in animo tuo imminutum esse, aut refrigeratum; opus igitur hoc nostrum longum & laboriosum animo, ut mea soles, benevolo suscipe, illiqve ut à cliente & domestico tuo proficiscenti benignus aspira; cum praeterita mente revolvo, vana spe me non delusum iri, certissima spes est, Morinumqve tuum & quidquid ab eo procedit, solito favore & benignitate te amplexurum & probaturum. Deum Opt. Max. etiam atqve etiam rogo, ut Eminentiam tuam & Ecclesiae & litaris incolumem quam diutissimé conservet.
Parisiis viij. Kal. Nove[illegible, ~4 letters]An. MDCLI.

page.notes: The date line is partly covered by a library stamp, so the middle of "Novemb." is unreadable and "An." is read from the visible end. The date numerals CIↃIↃCLI are read as MDCLI. "diutissimé" is printed with an acute accent on the final e, as shown. Several printing errors are left as printed: "illiqve", "litaris", "Morinumqve". Long s is written as s throughout.
